gloss: to catch; to capture; to seize

definitions.gloss: to catch; to capture; to seize (an animal, fish, criminal)
definitions.explanation: To physically catch or capture a moving creature or person — most often fish, insects, or game animals, or sometimes criminals. Used when the action involves chasing or grabbing.

examples.english: I caught fish in the river.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何時間|なんじかん}→何時間：30372_nanjikan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{捕|と}らえた。
examples.english: The police took several hours to apprehend the suspect.

notes:
Transitive godan verb (⟦{五段|ごだん}→五段：28275_godan⟧, ら-row stem). One of several とる verbs distinguished mainly by kanji choice — {捕|と}る specifically means catching a moving target (animals, criminals).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Transitive: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{捕|と}る
- No common intransitive pair; {捕|と}まる (to be caught) is the related intransitive.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{捕|と}る: to catch fish
- ⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{捕|と}る: to catch insects
- ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{捕|と}る: to catch a criminal
- ⟦{鼠|ねずみ}→鼠：02238_nezumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{捕|と}る: to catch mice (often said of cats)

KANJI DISTINCTIONS (とる homophones):
- ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take, to pick up — most general, default choice
- {捕|と}る: to catch, to capture — moving prey or criminals (this entry)
- ⟦{採|と}る→採る：20862_toru⟧: to gather, to adopt — collecting samples, harvesting, hiring
- ⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧: to take (a photo) — only for photos and video

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{捕|つか}まえる→捕まえる：01214_tsukamaeru⟧: to catch; to apprehend — emphasizes the act of grabbing hold; often interchangeable with {捕|と}る but more vivid
- ⟦{捕獲|ほかく}→捕獲：12881_hokaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to capture (formal) — used for wildlife management, escapees, etc.
